title: MarketPricesAndTechnicalAnalysis
description: Schema for storing current market share prices, daily trading volumes, dual nominal and split/dividend-adjusted historical OHLCV candlestick series, corporate action events, and technical analysis indicators supporting price prediction and grounded valuation.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol of the public equity.

current_price.description: Most recent verified market closing or regular trading price (on the active session, nominal and split-adjusted are identical).

previous_close.description: Official closing price of the prior regular trading session (split-adjusted).

nominal_previous_close.description: Nominal closing price of the prior regular trading session.

split_adj_previous_close.description: Split-adjusted closing price of the prior regular trading session.

adj_close.description: Total-return adjusted closing price (dividend- and split-adjusted).

day_change.description: Net price change in dollars relative to previous close.

day_change_percent.description: Percentage price change relative to previous close.

day_open.description: Opening price of the latest trading session.

day_high.description: Intraday high price of the latest trading session.

day_low.description: Intraday low price of the latest trading session.

day_volume.description: Total share volume traded during the latest regular session.

average_volume_20d.description: 20-day rolling average daily share trading volume.

volume_ratio.description: Ratio of latest day volume to 20-day average volume (identifies accumulation/distribution breakouts).

fifty_two_week_high.description: Highest traded price in the preceding 52-week trailing window (split-adjusted).

fifty_two_week_low.description: Lowest traded price in the preceding 52-week trailing window (split-adjusted).

sma_20.description: 20-day Simple Moving Average (short-term trend & mean reversion benchmark, split-adjusted).

sma_50.description: 50-day Simple Moving Average (intermediate institutional support/resistance level, split-adjusted).

technical_support_20d.description: Estimated short-term support level based on recent 20-day swing lows.

technical_resistance_20d.description: Estimated short-term resistance level based on recent 20-day swing highs.

cumulative_split_factor.description: Cumulative split factor applicable across the series window.

recent_splits.description: List of recent stock splits and reverse splits recorded for this equity.

recent_dividends.description: List of recent cash dividend distributions recorded for this equity.

historical_candles_30d.description: Chronological array of daily OHLCV candlestick records containing dual nominal and split/dividend-adjusted prices.

nominal_open.description: Nominal unadjusted opening price traded on the exchange floor on this date.

nominal_close.description: Nominal unadjusted closing price (matches historical press releases and news articles).

nominal_volume.description: Actual nominal share volume traded on this session.

adj_close.description: Total return adjusted closing price (backward-adjusted for forward/reverse splits and cash dividends).

open.description: Session opening price (split-adjusted alias for backward compatibility).

high.description: Session high price (split-adjusted alias for backward compatibility).

low.description: Session low price (split-adjusted alias for backward compatibility).

close.description: Session closing price (split-adjusted alias for backward compatibility).

volume.description: Session trading volume in shares (split-adjusted alias for backward compatibility).

split_factor.description: Cumulative split multiplier at this date (Nominal = Split-Adj * split_factor).

split_ratio.description: Split ratio string if a split or reverse split occurred on this date (e.g. '10:1', '1:5'), otherwise null.

dividend_amount.description: Cash dividend per share paid on this ex-dividend date, otherwise null.

provenance_source.description: Authoritative feed or API endpoint name.
